ABSM 100.name: Growing Your Future--First-Year Seminar
ABSM 100.description: Introduces students to the university and breadth of BE/ABSM programs through hands-on lab activities in the program focus areas.

ABSM 300.name: Introduction to Agricultural and Biorenewable Products
ABSM 300.description: Overview of bioproducts production and sustainability considerations. Enforced concurrent enrollment in CHEM 110.

ABSM 301.name: Engineering Principles of Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems
ABSM 301.description: Problem-solving using physics and mathematics for agricultural systems.

ABSM 350.name: Introduction to Life Cycle Assessment
ABSM 350.description: Quantitative approach to assessing environmental and economic impacts. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly -- the plan schedules this course no earlier than its intended term.

ABSM 391.name: Communication Skills for BE and ABSM Students
ABSM 391.description: Discipline-specific communication and leadership skills training. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly -- the plan schedules this course no earlier than its intended term.

ABSM 392.name: Leadership and Ethics for BE and ABSM Students
ABSM 392.description: Focus on leadership, communication, ethics, and sustainability. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

ABSM 422.name: Energy Analysis in Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems
ABSM 422.description: Energy forms analysis and engineering economic applications.

ABSM 426.name: Safety and Health in Agriculture and Biorenewable Industries
ABSM 426.description: Occupational safety management specific to agriculture. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

ABSM 428.name: Electric Power and Instrumentation
ABSM 428.description: Electrical systems analysis for agricultural/biorenewable industries.

ABSM 429.name: Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Analysis and Management
ABSM 429.description: Systems analysis and optimization techniques for decision-making. Bulletin requires 7th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly -- the plan schedules this course no earlier than its intended term.

ABSM 430W.name: Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Management Capstone 1
ABSM 430W.description: Fall component introducing capstone project concepts and proposal development. Concurrent with ABSM 429.

ABSM 431W.name: Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Management Capstone 2
ABSM 431W.description: Spring component applying tools to analyze real-world systems.

ABSM 490.name: Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Management Colloquium
ABSM 490.description: Industry perspectives on current challenges, opportunities, and future trends. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.
